photos.c: It's great to have such people as Gill Fairclough to rely upon. Gill has been associated with Belgrave for many years, husband Tony being one of our star cross country runners from the '60s. Both Gill and Tony have gone on to put something back into the sport and do a great deal of officiating, particularly in Kent. At our home McDonald's YA Meeting at Crystal Palace Gill took on the arduous role of Field Events Referee while Tony was Track Ref. What would we have done without them?
